introduction: Getting something from the kurzgesagt shop is the best way to support us and to keep our videos free

vocabulary.definition: The curved path followed by a celestial body or artificial satellite around a star, planet, or moon.
vocabulary.example: The Earth orbits around the Sun once every year.

vocabulary.definition: Move in a winding or circular course that radiates from a central point.
vocabulary.example: The hurricane spirals towards the coastline.

vocabulary.definition: The controlled distribution of scarce resources, goods, or services.
vocabulary.example: During the war, food rationing was implemented to ensure everyone received their fair share.

vocabulary.definition: Having an orbital period that is the same as the rotational period of the body being orbited.
vocabulary.example: Geosynchronous satellites remain fixed over a specific point on the Earth's surface.

vocabulary.definition: A great disaster resulting in widespread destruction and devastation.
vocabulary.example: The movie depicted an apocalypse caused by a deadly virus outbreak.

vocabulary.definition: The distance within which a celestial body, held together only by its own gravity, will disintegrate due to a stronger gravitational force from another body.
vocabulary.example: When the moon crosses the Roche limit, it will break apart and form a ring around the Earth.
